inspection_method: local git checkout; inspected README, Obsidian config, recipe template, manual index, exported docs, image/PDF folders, and sample notes

anchors.why: Describes the repository as an Obsidian recipe vault exported to a web format through an Obsidian webpage export plugin.
Defines recipe frontmatter and body sections: name, source, difficulty, time, tags, type, image, ingredients, preparation, notes, nutrition, sources, and references.
Shows hand-maintained category navigation using Obsidian wikilinks across food categories.
Shows the active export plugin boundary for converting the vault to a public site.
Contains exported HTML pages, demonstrating source vault versus generated web output separation.

known_limits: The recipe notes include source labels of mixed rigor; they are not evidence packets.
Manual indexes can drift from actual files.
Exported docs duplicate source content and should not be treated as separate authority.
